items.title: Prudential Financial (PRU) Prepares To Resume Japan Business
items.summary: Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) is moving ahead with a phased re entry into Japan after a prior sales suspension. The insurer is putting enhanced governance measures in place as it prepares to restart Japanese operations. Management has completed sales of businesses in Brazil, Mexico, South Africa, Indonesia, and Kenya to narrow its international footprint. items.title: At 70 He’ll Get a Letter Saying His Company Is Handing His Pension to an Insurance Company. The Check Stays the Same, but the Federal Safety Net Behind It Doesn’t
